Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub:  Intimation under Regulation 30 and 46 of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations 2015 (the ‘Listing Regulations’)- Audio recording of the 
Investors’ Conference Call on the Financial Results for the Second 
Quarter and Half Year ended on September 30, 2026 
 
With reference to our letter dated October 23, 2026, and pursuant to Regulation 30 
and 46 of the Listing Regulations, we hereby inform you that the audio recording of 
the Investors’ Conference Call on the Financial Results for the Second Quarter and 
Half Year ended on September 30, 2026, is made available on the website of the 
Company under the weblink at https://www.bluestarindia.com/investors/schedule-of-
analysts-or-institutional-investors-meet#investors-concall-recording.  
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you,  
Yours faithfully,  
 For Blue Star Limited 
  
 
                                           
 Rajesh Parte 
 Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
